question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is-' **Arrive'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arrive** means to come or happen

 **E.g.**__** **-The day of the wedding had finally **arrived**.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Arrive' **according to the context of the given passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Awake**__ means to wake up; to make somebody/something wake up.
 
• __**Arise**__ means to begin to exist; to appear.
 
• __**Abase**__ means to behave in a way that belittles or degrades (someone).
